measurement_limitations.consequence: No safety-event labels or safety-violation verdicts may be produced.
Task goals alone do not establish which contacts are unsafe.
Do not invent fragile objects or infer damage from names or task failure.
Control-step snapshots cannot prove absence of intervening contact.
XML/asset provenance permits future derivation; a root pose alone does not prove a fall.
No numeric safety limits are supplied or inferred.
Body cfrc_ext and named sensor channels are not per-contact force labels.
Actual XML sensor declarations and raw sensordata are preserved; validate version-specific channel mapping before force checking.
